name: dialog-with-form
description: Opens a MatDialog containing a Reactive Forms form, passing initial data in via MAT_DIALOG_DATA and returning the edited result through MatDialogRef.close().

notes: The [disabled] binding on the submit button reflects the FormGroup created inside the dialog component, not the parent — validation state doesn't automatically propagate back to the component that called open().
Data passed through the dialog's close(result) must be plain data, not the FormGroup/FormControl instances themselves, since afterClosed() consumers shouldn't need @angular/forms to read the result.
Type MatDialogRef<T, R> with the result type R so afterClosed() gives you a typed Observable instead of unknown.
